collection.title: Daihatsu Fourtrak 1984 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Daihatsu Fourtrak 1984 to 2002 requires a 15" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Fourtrak which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
